title: Align task-sync prepared export alias bindings with publication capture
outcome: Make prepared-but-unconfirmed outgoing shared members use one consistent alias-binding rule in export capture and echo admission.
acceptance: Preparing an outgoing export under alias A without confirmation cannot later permit an alias B export whose returned echo is permanently refused only because of the prepared-only alias witness.
Tests cover an unconfirmed outgoing preparation followed by another alias and returned shared note/activity, with actionable refusal or successful consistent admission.
Confirmed and admitted identity ownership remains immutable, with no execution authority gained through import.
